set.text: SHOP STREET · 2:00 PM. Sunny. Vending machines hum. Nanda pulls you to a shop.

beats.text: She pulls you to the self-checkout. No shop lady there.
You walk past the sweets. She does not look at them. She looks at you.
Checkout. Lane 2 is open. You put the basket on the counter.
The shop doors slide open. A little tune plays.

beats.speaker: NANDA
beats.text: Carrots, eggs, three cups, and you. My whole list. ♡
Your hands push the cart. Her hand slides on top of yours.

choices.react: You forgot my list. Next time I write it on your hand.
Almost perfect. I still keep you. ♡
Every item, first try. You know me. ♡
